title: Redressal of Investor Grievances
summary: Investment Advisers must redress investor grievances through SEBI Complaints Redress system (SCORES) Platform and Online Dispute Resolution (ODR) Platform
required_action: Redress investor grievances through SCORES and ODR platforms
verbatim_text: Redressal of investor grievances through SEBI Complaints Redress system (SCORES) Platform and Online Dispute Resolution (ODR) Platform

title: Know Your Client (KYC) Norms
summary: Investment Advisers must follow Know Your Client (KYC) norms for the securities market
required_action: Follow KYC norms
verbatim_text: Know Your Client (KYC) norms for the securities market

title: Anti-Money Laundering (AML) Standards
summary: Investment Advisers must follow Anti-Money Laundering (AML) Standards and Combating the Financing of Terrorism (CFT) obligations
required_action: Follow AML and CFT obligations
evidence: AML and CFT policies and procedures
verbatim_text: Guidelines on Anti-Money Laundering (AML) Standards and Combating the Financing of Terrorism (CFT) /Obligations of Securities Market Intermediaries under the Prevention of Money Laundering Act, 2002 and Rules framed there under

title: Periodic Reporting
summary: Investment Advisers must submit periodic reports in the specified format
required_action: Submit periodic reports
verbatim_text: Periodic reporting format for Investment Advisers

title: Client Level Segregation of Advisory and Distribution Activities
summary: Ensure client level segregation at IA's group/family level
trigger: When providing advisory or distribution services
required_action: Adopt compliance and monitoring process for client level segregation
source_circular: SEBI/HO/IMD/DF1/CIR/P/2020/182 dated September 23, 2020 and SEBI/HO/MIRSD/ MIRSD-PoD-1/P/CIR/2025/003 dated January 08, 2025
verbatim_text: To ensure client level segregation at IA's group/family level, as per Regulation 22(5) of the IA Regulations, following compliance and monitoring process shall be adopted

title: Determine Client Eligibility for Advisory or Distribution Services
summary: Determine client eligibility for advisory or distribution services
required_action: Make option to avail either advisory services or distribution services available to the client
source_clause: (b) A new client will be eligible to avail either advisory or distribution services within the group/family of IA
source_circular: SEBI/HO/IMD/DF1/CIR/P/2020/182 dated September 23, 2020 and SEBI/HO/MIRSD/ MIRSD-PoD-1/P/CIR/2025/003 dated January 08, 2025
verbatim_text: A new client will be eligible to avail either advisory or distribution services within the group/family of IA. However, the option to avail either advisory services or distribution services shall be made available to such client at the time of on boarding

title: Respect Client Discretion for Holding Assets
summary: Respect client discretion for holding assets prior to segregation
required_action: Allow clients to continue holding assets prior to segregation
source_clause: (d) The client shall have discretion to continue holding assets prior to the applicability of this segregation under the existing advisory/distribution arrangement
source_circular: SEBI/HO/IMD/DF1/CIR/P/2020/182 dated September 23, 2020 and SEBI/HO/MIRSD/ MIRSD-PoD-1/P/CIR/2025/003 dated January 08, 2025
verbatim_text: The client shall have discretion to continue holding assets prior to the applicability of this segregation under the existing advisory/distribution arrangement. However, the client shall not be forced to liquidate/switch such existing holdings

title: Maintain PAN Records for Client Identification
summary: Use PAN as control record for client identification and segregation
required_action: Use PAN as control record for client identification and segregation
source_clause: (e) Permanent Account Number (PAN) of each client shall be the control record for identification and client level segregation
source_circular: SEBI/HO/IMD/DF1/CIR/P/2020/182 dated September 23, 2020 and SEBI/HO/MIRSD/ MIRSD-PoD-1/P/CIR/2025/003 dated January 08, 2025
verbatim_text: Permanent Account Number (PAN) of each client shall be the control record for identification and client level segregation

title: Advise Direct Plans
summary: Investment Adviser must advise direct plans of products
trigger: When advising clients on investment products
required_action: Advise direct plans (non-commission based) of products
evidence: Record of advice provided to clients
verbatim_text: IA shall, wherever available, advise direct plans (non-commission based) of products only.

title: Enter into Investment Advisory Agreement
summary: Investment Adviser must enter into an investment advisory agreement with clients
trigger: When providing investment advisory services to clients
required_action: Enter into an investment advisory agreement with clients
verbatim_text: Regulation 19(1)(d) of the IA Regulations provides that IA shall enter into an investment advisory agreement with its clients.

title: Incorporate MITC into Agreement
summary: Investment Adviser must incorporate MITC into the investment advisory agreement
trigger: When entering into an investment advisory agreement
required_action: Incorporate MITC into the agreement
evidence: Copy of the agreement with MITC
verbatim_text: IA shall incorporate the MITC into the investment advisory agreement and shall disclose and take consent from clients on the agreement.

title: Obtain Client Consent
summary: Investment Adviser must obtain client consent to the agreement
trigger: When entering into an investment advisory agreement
required_action: Obtain client consent to the agreement
verbatim_text: Consent of client to agreement between IA and client may be signed by the client in person or through any other legally acceptable mode including DigiLocker enabled Aadhaar based e-signature facility.

title: Obtain Annual Certificate
summary: Investment Adviser must obtain an annual certificate from an auditor
required_action: Obtain an annual certificate from an auditor
deadline: within 6 months of the end of the financial year
verbatim_text: The IAs shall maintain on record an annual certificate from an auditor confirming compliance with the client level segregation requirements as specified in Regulation 22 of the IA Regulations.

title: Charge Fees Only After Agreement
summary: Charge fees from clients only after they have signed the agreement
required_action: Charge fees from client
verbatim_text: IA shall ensure that neither any investment advice is rendered nor any fee is charged until the client has signed the aforesaid agreement and provided copy of signed agreement to the client.

title: Comply with Fee Limits
summary: Comply with the fee limits specified by SEBI
required_action: Comply with fee limits
verbatim_text: IAs can charge fees under two modes, namely, (i) Assets under Advice (‘AUA’) mode, which is subject to a limit of 2.5 per cent of AUA per annum per family of client across all services offered by IA, and (ii) Fixed fee mode, which is subject to a specified fee limit

title: Demonstrate AUA with Supporting Documents
summary: Demonstrate AUA with supporting documents like demat statements, unit statements etc.
required_action: Provide supporting documents for AUA
evidence: Supporting documents like demat statements, unit statements etc.
verbatim_text: IA shall be required to demonstrate AUA with supporting documents like demat statements, unit statements etc. of the client.

title: Deduct Pre-Existing Arrangements from AUA
summary: Deduct any pre-existing distribution arrangements from AUA when charging fees
required_action: Deduct pre-existing arrangements from AUA
verbatim_text: Any portion of AUA held by the client under any pre-existing distribution arrangement with any entity shall be deducted from AUA for the purpose of charging fee by the IA.

title: Fee Advance Limit
summary: Investment Advisers may charge fees in advance, but not exceeding fees for a period of one year
required_action: Charge fees in advance, not exceeding one year
verbatim_text: If agreed by the client, IAs may charge fees in advance, however, such advance shall not exceed fees for a period of one year.

title: Fee Refund
summary: Investment Advisers must refund fees for unexpired period in case of premature termination
required_action: Refund fees for unexpired period
verbatim_text: In the event of pre-mature termination of the IA services in terms of agreement, the client shall be refunded the fees for unexpired period.

title: Fee Breakage
summary: Investment Advisers may retain a maximum breakage fee of not greater than one-quarter fee
required_action: Retain breakage fee, not exceeding one-quarter fee
verbatim_text: However, IA may retain a maximum breakage fee of not greater than one-quarter fee.

title: Deposit Requirement
summary: Investment Advisers must maintain a deposit based on the maximum number of clients
required_action: Maintain deposit as per SEBI requirements
verbatim_text: As per Regulation 8 of the IA Regulations, an investment adviser shall maintain a deposit of such sum, as specified by SEBI from time to time.

title: Deposit Maintenance
summary: Investment Advisers must maintain the deposit with a scheduled bank marked as lien in favor of IAASB
required_action: Maintain deposit with scheduled bank
verbatim_text: The deposit shall be maintained with a scheduled bank marked as lien in favor of Investment Adviser Administration and Supervisory body (IAASB), in the manner and form as may be specified by IAASB.

title: Deposit Revision
summary: Investment Advisers must revise the deposit amount based on the maximum number of clients
required_action: Revise deposit amount
deadline: 30th April of the subsequent financial year
verbatim_text: The deposit amount may be revised for any change in applicable amount of deposit, based on the maximum number of clients on any day in the previous financial year, latest by 30th April of the subsequent financial year.

title: Meet Qualification and Certification Requirement
summary: Individual investment advisers or principal officer of a non-individual investment adviser and persons associated with investment advice must meet the enhanced qualification and experience requirement
required_action: Comply with the enhanced qualification and experience requirement within the specified time period
deadline: within five years i.e. up to September 30, 2025
verbatim_text: Existing Individual investment advisers or principal officer of a non-individual investment adviser and persons associated with investment advice as on September 30, 2020 were required to comply with the enhanced qualification and experience requirement within a period of five years i.e. up to September 30, 2025

title: Apply for In-Principle Registration as Non-Individual Investment Adviser
summary: Individual investment advisers whose number of clients exceed three hundred or the fee collected during the financial year exceeds three crore rupees must apply for in-principle registration as non-individual investment adviser
trigger: Number of clients exceeds three hundred or fee collected exceeds three crore rupees
required_action: Apply for in-principle registration as non-individual investment adviser
deadline: within the specified time limit
source_circular: SEBI Master Circular for Investment Advisers
verbatim_text: As per Regulation 13(e) of the IA Regulations, an individual IA, whose number of clients exceed three hundred at any point of time or the fee collected during the financial year exceeds three crore rupees, whichever is earlier, is required to apply for in-principle registration as non-individual IA

title: Complete Transition Process
summary: Individual investment advisers who apply for in-principle registration as non-individual investment adviser must complete the transition process within the specified time limit
trigger: Application for in-principle registration as non-individual investment adviser
required_action: Complete the transition process
deadline: within three months
source_circular: SEBI Master Circular for Investment Advisers
verbatim_text: In order to ease the process of transition from individual IA to non-individual IA, an individual IA shall initially be required to apply for grant of in-principle registration as non-individual IA which shall be valid for a period of up to three months within which time, the IA is required to complete the transition process

title: Continue servicing existing clients during transition
summary: Continue servicing existing clients during transition to non-individual IA
required_action: Continue servicing existing clients
verbatim_text: individual IA shall continue to service existing clients

title: Segregate investment advisory and research services
summary: Segregate investment advisory and research services for dual-registered IAs
trigger: Dual registration as IA and RA
required_action: Segregate investment advisory and research services
verbatim_text: it shall comply with the rules/regulations/reporting requirements under each of these regulations

title: Maintain arms-length relationship between IA and RA activities
summary: Maintain arms-length relationship between IA and RA activities for dual-registered IAs
trigger: Dual registration as IA and RA
required_action: Maintain arms-length relationship between IA and RA activities
evidence: Undertaking stating maintenance of arms-length relationship
verbatim_text: it shall maintain arms-length relationship between its activity as IA and RA

title: Meet eligibility criteria for part-time IA registration
summary: Meet eligibility criteria for part-time IA registration
required_action: Meet eligibility criteria
verbatim_text: a part-time IA is an individual or partnership firm who is also engaged in any other business activity/employment

title: Provide undertaking for part-time IA registration
summary: Provide undertaking for part-time IA registration
required_action: Provide undertaking
verbatim_text: Part-time IA shall provide an undertaking stating that it shall maintain arms-length relationship

title: Maintain Arms-Length Relationship
summary: Maintain arms-length relationship between investment advisory activity and other activities
trigger: Engagement in investment advisory activity and other activities
required_action: Maintain arms-length relationship
evidence: Undertaking stating maintenance of arms-length relationship
verbatim_text: shall maintain arms-length relationship between its activity as IA and other activities

title: Provide Disclaimer for Non-SEBI Services
summary: Provide disclaimer for services not under SEBI purview
trigger: Providing services not under SEBI purview
required_action: Provide disclaimer
evidence: Disclaimer on invoices or service documents
verbatim_text: Part-time IA shall provide disclaimer prominently (minimum 10 font size) and attracting the attention of the investor while providing their other service/raising invoice related to other business/service that the activity/invoice is related to services not under purview of SEBI and no complaint can be raised to SEBI for the services rendered therein

title: Disclose Conflict of Interest
summary: Disclose nature of other activities and ensure no conflict of interest
required_action: Disclose nature of other activities and ensure no conflict of interest
verbatim_text: The part-time IA shall disclose the nature of other activities to their clients and shall ensure that there is no conflict of interest between its IA activity and its other business activities or employment

title: Designation of Principal Officer
summary: Designate a principal officer in case of non-individual investment adviser
required_action: Designate a principal officer
verbatim_text: in case of non-individual investment adviser being a partnership firm, one of the partners shall be designated as its principal officer.

title: Registration as Limited Liability Partnership
summary: Register as a limited liability partnership if no partner meets qualification requirements
trigger: No partner meets minimum qualification and certification requirements
required_action: Register as a limited liability partnership
deadline: September 30, 2025
verbatim_text: a partnership firm registered as an investment adviser, where no partner of the firm has the minimum qualification and certification requirements provided under the Regulations, shall apply for registration as an investment adviser in the form of a limited liability partnership or a body corporate latest by September 30, 2025.

title: Appointment of Compliance Officer
summary: Appoint an independent professional as compliance officer
required_action: Appoint an independent professional as compliance officer
verbatim_text: a non-individual investment adviser may appoint an independent professional who is a member of ICAI or ICSI or ICMAI or member of any other professional body as may be specified by the SEBI, provided such a professional holds a relevant certification from NISM, as may be specified by the SEBI.

title: Disclosure for Non-SEBI Products
summary: Make disclosure to clients about non-SEBI products and obtain declaration and undertaking
trigger: Providing investment advice on non-SEBI products
required_action: Make disclosure and obtain declaration and undertaking from clients
evidence: Record of disclosure and client declaration/undertaking
deadline: July 31, 2025 for existing clients
verbatim_text: For the products and services not under the purview of SEBI, IA shall make disclosure to the client and take appropriate declaration and undertaking from the client

title: Disclosure of AI Tool Usage
summary: Disclose the extent of AI tool usage in providing investment advice
trigger: Using AI tools for investment advice
required_action: Disclose AI tool usage to clients
verbatim_text: an investment adviser shall disclose to the client the extent of use of Artificial Intelligence tools in providing investment advice

title: Responsibility for AI Tool Usage
summary: Be responsible for security, confidentiality, and integrity of client data when using AI tools
trigger: Using AI tools for investment advice
required_action: Ensure security, confidentiality, and integrity of client data
evidence: Records of AI tool usage and data protection measures
verbatim_text: an investment adviser who uses Artificial Intelligence tools, irrespective of the scale and scenario of adoption of such tools, for servicing its clients shall be solely responsible for the security, confidentiality, integrity of the client data

title: Record Keeping
summary: Maintain records of interactions with clients
required_action: Maintain records of interactions
verbatim_text: IA shall maintain records with respect to his activities as an IA

title: Maintain Call Recording for Implementation/Execution Consent
summary: Maintain call recording of every consent for implementation/execution obtained from the client if advice/execution is given through telephone call
trigger: Providing implementation/execution services to advisory clients
required_action: Maintain call recording of every consent for implementation/execution
verbatim_text: IAs providing implementation/execution services shall maintain call recording of every consent for implementation/execution obtained from the client if advice/execution is given through telephone call

title: Conduct Annual Audit
summary: Conduct annual audit in respect of compliance with SEBI (Investment Advisers) Regulations, 2013 and circulars issued thereunder
required_action: Conduct annual audit
deadline: Within six months from the end of each financial year
verbatim_text: IA shall conduct annual audit in respect of compliance with SEBI (Investment Advisers) Regulations, 2013 and circulars issued thereunder

title: Submit Audit Report to IAASB/SEBI
summary: Submit a compliance audit report to IAASB/SEBI within a period of one month from the date of the audit report
required_action: Submit audit report to IAASB/SEBI
deadline: Within one month from the date of the audit report
verbatim_text: An IA shall submit a compliance audit report to IAASB/SEBI within a period of one month from the date of the audit report

title: Submit Adverse Findings to IAASB/SEBI
summary: Submit adverse findings of audit, if any, along with action taken thereof to IAASB/SEBI within a period of one month from the date of the audit report
trigger: Identification of adverse findings during audit
required_action: Submit adverse findings to IAASB/SEBI
deadline: Within one month from the date of the audit report
verbatim_text: An IA shall submit adverse findings of audit, if any, along with action taken thereof to IAASB/SEBI within a period of one month from the date of the audit report

title: Publish Audit Report on Website
summary: Publish the status of the compliance audit report on the website and publish the adverse findings of audit, if any, along with the action taken thereof on the website
required_action: Publish audit report on website
verbatim_text: IA shall publish the status of the compliance audit report on its website and shall also publish the adverse findings of audit, if any, along with the action taken thereof on their website

title: Conduct Risk Profiling and Suitability for Non-Individual Clients
summary: Use the investment policy as approved by the board/management team of non-individual clients for risk profiling and suitability analysis
required_action: Conduct risk profiling and suitability analysis
evidence: Risk profiling and suitability analysis records
source_clause: (xv) Risk profiling and suitability for non-individual clients (b)
verbatim_text: IA shall use the investment policy as approved by board/management team of such non-individual clients for risk profiling and suitability analysis

title: Maintain a Functional Website
summary: Maintain a functional website containing specified details
required_action: Maintain a functional website with specified details
verbatim_text: In terms of Regulation 19A of IA Regulations, an investment adviser shall maintain a functional website, which shall contain the details as may be specified by SEBI

title: Display Specified Information on Website
summary: Display specified information on the website, mobile app, and other communication channels
required_action: Display specified information on the website, mobile app, and other communication channels
evidence: Specified information displayed on the website, mobile app, and other communication channels
source_clause: (xvii) Display of details on website and in other communication channels
verbatim_text: the IAs shall display the following information prominently on its website, mobile app, printed or electronic materials, know your client forms, client agreements and other correspondences with the clients

title: No Free Trial for Products/Services
summary: Not provide free trial for any products/services to prospective clients
required_action: Not provide free trial for any products/services
evidence: No free trial provided to prospective clients
verbatim_text: Hence the IAs shall not provide free trial for any products/services to prospective clients

title: Obtain Consent for Risk Profiling
summary: Obtain consent of the client on completed risk profile
required_action: Obtain consent of the client on completed risk profile
source_clause: 2.2 Proper risk profiling and consent of client on risk profiling
verbatim_text: Obtain consent of the client on completed risk profile either through registered email or physical document

title: Receive Fees through Banking Channel
summary: Receive advisory fees through banking channels only
required_action: Receive advisory fees through banking channels only
evidence: Record of fees received through banking channels
source_clause: 2.3 Receiving fees though banking channel only
verbatim_text: IAs shall receive advisory fee through banking channel only

title: Accept fees through approved channels
summary: Investment Advisers must accept fees only through account payee crossed cheques, demand draft, or direct credit into their bank account
required_action: Accept fees through approved channels
verbatim_text: IAs shall accept fees strictly by account payee crossed cheques / demand draft or by way of direct credit into their bank account through NEFT/ RTGS/IMPS/UPI

title: Display complaints status on website
summary: Investment Advisers must display complaints status on their website
required_action: Display complaints status on website
deadline: within 7 days of end of the previous month
verbatim_text: IAs shall display the following information on the homepage (without scrolling) of their website/mobile app

title: Enlistment with IAASB
summary: Investment Advisers must enlist with IAASB
required_action: Enlist with IAASB
verbatim_text: an applicant seeking registration as RA and IA is required to be enlisted with RAASB and IAASB respectively

title: Pay Administrative Fees
summary: Investment Advisers must pay administrative fees to RAASB/IAASB
required_action: Pay administrative fees as specified by RAASB/IAASB
verbatim_text: Applicants seeking registration/renewal as RA/IA shall be liable to pay administrative fees, as specified by RAASB/IAASB.

title: Bring Investor Charter to Client Notice
summary: Investment Advisers must bring the investor charter to the notice of their clients
required_action: Disclose Investor Charter on website, mobile app, and provide a copy during client on-boarding
evidence: Record of disclosure on website, mobile app, and client on-boarding documents
verbatim_text: All IAs are required to bring the investor charter to the notice of their clients.

title: Disclose Complaints and Redressal Data
summary: Investment Advisers must disclose data on complaints received and redressal
required_action: Disclose complaints and redressal data on website and mobile app by 7th of succeeding month
evidence: Record of disclosure on website and mobile app
deadline: 7th of succeeding month
verbatim_text: all the Investment Advisers shall continue to disclose on their respective websites and mobile applications (if any), the data on complaints received against them or against issues dealt by them and redressal thereof, latest by 7th of succeeding month

title: Obtain Prior Approval for Change in Control
summary: Investment Advisers must obtain prior approval from SEBI for change in control
required_action: Obtain prior approval from SEBI
evidence: Record of prior approval from SEBI
verbatim_text: IA shall obtain prior approval of SEBI in case of change in control.

title: Obtain Prior Approval for Change in Control
summary: Investment Adviser must obtain prior approval from SEBI in case of change in control
required_action: Make an online application to SEBI for prior approval
evidence: Copy of approval letter from SEBI
deadline: within six months from the date of approval
verbatim_text: IA shall obtain prior approval of SEBI in case of change in control.

title: Provide Information and Declarations for Prior Approval
summary: Investment Adviser must provide required information and declarations for prior approval
required_action: Provide information and declarations as specified in 8.2.ii
evidence: Copy of online application and supporting documents
verbatim_text: The online application shall be accompanied by the following information/ declaration/ undertaking about itself, the acquirer(s)/ the person(s) who shall have the control and the directors/ partners of the acquirer(s)/ the person(s) who shall have the control:

title: Inform Existing Investors about Change in Control
summary: Investment Adviser must inform existing investors about the proposed change in control
trigger: Grant of prior approval by SEBI
required_action: Inform all existing investors about the proposed change prior to effecting the same
evidence: Record of notification to existing investors
verbatim_text: pursuant to grant of prior approval by SEBI, the incumbent shall inform all the existing investors/ clients about the proposed change prior to effecting the same, in order to enable them to take informed decision regarding their continuance or otherwise with the new management;

title: Comply with Fit and Proper Person Criteria
summary: Investment Adviser must comply with the fit and proper person criteria
required_action: Comply with the fit and proper person criteria as specified in Schedule II of Securities and Exchange Board of India (Intermediaries) Regulations, 2008
evidence: Declaration cum undertaking as specified in Annexure G
verbatim_text: the ‘fit and proper person’ criteria as specified in Schedule II of Securities and Exchange Board of India (Intermediaries) Regulations, 2008 are complied with.

title: Obtain Approval/NOC from Stock Exchanges/Clearing Corporations/Depositories
summary: Investment Adviser must obtain approval/NOC from stock exchanges/clearing corporations/depositories
required_action: Obtain approval/NOC from all the stock exchanges/clearing corporations/depositories where the incumbent is a member/depository participant
evidence: Self-attested copy of approval/NOC from stock exchanges/clearing corporations/depositories
verbatim_text: In case the incumbent is a registered stock broker, clearing member, depository participant, in addition to the above, it shall obtain approval /NOC from all the stock exchanges/clearing corporations/depositories, where the incumbent is a member/depository participant and submit self-attested copy of the same to SEBI.

title: Submit online application for final approval
summary: Investment Adviser must submit online application for final approval after NCLT order
required_action: Submit online application with required documents
deadline: within 15 days from the date of order of NCLT
verbatim_text: Within 15 days from the date of order of NCLT, the IA shall submit an online application in terms of clause 8.2 along with the following documents to SEBI for final approval

title: File application with SEBI prior to filing with NCLT
summary: Investment Adviser must file application with SEBI prior to filing with NCLT
required_action: File application with SEBI
verbatim_text: The application seeking approval for the proposed change in control of the IA shall be filed with SEBI prior to filing the application with NCLT.

title: Obtain prior approval for transfer of shareholding in proprietary firm
summary: The legal heir / transferee must obtain prior approval and fresh registration in case of transfer of shareholding in a proprietary firm
trigger: Transfer of shareholding in a proprietary firm
required_action: Obtain prior approval and fresh registration
evidence: Approval letter and fresh registration certificate
deadline: within the timeframe specified by SEBI
verbatim_text: The legal heir / transferee in such cases is required to obtain prior approval and thereafter fresh registration shall be obtained in the name of legal heir/transferee.

title: Obtain prior approval for transfer of ownership interest in partnership firm with two partners
summary: The partnership firm must obtain prior approval and fresh registration in case of transfer of ownership interest with two partners
trigger: Transfer of ownership interest in a partnership firm with two partners
required_action: Obtain prior approval and fresh registration
evidence: Approval letter and fresh registration certificate
deadline: within the timeframe specified by SEBI
verbatim_text: if a new partner is inducted in the firm, then the same would be considered as a change in control, requiring fresh registration and prior approval of SEBI.

title: Ensure incoming entities/shareholders satisfy fit and proper person criteria
summary: Incoming entities/shareholders must satisfy the fit and proper person criteria stipulated in Schedule II of SEBI (Intermediaries) Regulations, 2008
trigger: Incoming entities/shareholders becoming part of controlling interest
required_action: Ensure incoming entities/shareholders satisfy fit and proper person criteria
evidence: Documentation of fit and proper person criteria satisfaction
deadline: prior to the incoming entities/shareholders becoming part of controlling interest
verbatim_text: Incoming entities/ shareholders becoming part of controlling interest in the intermediary pursuant to transfer of shares from immediate relative / transmission of shares (immediate relative or not), need to satisfy the fit and proper person criteria stipulated in Schedule II of SEBI (Intermediaries) Regulations, 2008.

title: Ensure compliance with the advertisement code
summary: Investment Advisers must ensure compliance with the advertisement code as prescribed
required_action: Ensure compliance with the advertisement code
verbatim_text: Investment Advisers shall ensure compliance with the advertisement code as prescribed below:

title: Include all forms of communications in advertisement
summary: Advertisement shall include all forms of communications that may influence investment decisions
required_action: Include all forms of communications in advertisement
verbatim_text: Advertisement shall include all forms of communications, issued by or on behalf of IA, that may influence investment decisions of any investor or prospective investor.

title: Include specific information in advertisement
summary: Advertisement shall contain specific information such as name of IA, registered office address, SEBI Registration No., etc.
required_action: Include specific information in advertisement
verbatim_text: The information/disclosures that the advertisement shall contain, include the following- Name of the IA as registered with SEBI, registered office address, SEBI Registration No., logo/brand name/trade name of IA, and CIN of the IA, if applicable.

title: Ensure accuracy and completeness of information in advertisement
summary: Information in advertisement shall be accurate, true and complete in unambiguous and concise language
required_action: Ensure accuracy and completeness of information in advertisement
verbatim_text: Information which is accurate, true and complete in unambiguous and concise language.

title: Include standard warning in advertisement
summary: Advertisement shall include standard warning in legible fonts
required_action: Include standard warning in advertisement
verbatim_text: Standard warning in legible fonts (minimum 10 font size) which states “Investment in securities market are subject to market risks. Read all the related documents carefully before investing”.

title: Ensure standard warning is audible in audio-visual media based advertisements
summary: Standard warning in audio-visual media based advertisements shall be audible in a clear and understandable manner
trigger: Issuance of audio-visual media based advertisement
required_action: Ensure standard warning is audible in audio-visual media based advertisements
verbatim_text: In audio-visual media based advertisements, the standard warning in visual media based advertisement and accompanying voice over reiteration shall be audible in a clear and understandable manner.

title: Ensure standard warning is accurately translated in non-English advertisements
summary: Standard warning in non-English advertisements shall be accurately translated
required_action: Ensure standard warning is accurately translated in non-English advertisements
verbatim_text: Whenever the advertisement is being issued in a language other than English, it will be ensured that the standard warning is accurately translated in the language of the advertisement.

title: Provide official website hyperlink in certain advertisements
summary: Official website hyperlink shall be provided in certain advertisements such as SMS/Message/Pop-up, social media etc.
required_action: Provide official website hyperlink in certain advertisements
verbatim_text: In case the mode of advertisement is SMS/Message/Pop-up, social media etc. and the details such as full name, logo/brand name, full registered office address, SEBI registration number, membership number of a SEBI recognized supervisory body and standard disclaimer are not mentioned, then official website hyperlink should be provided in such SMS/Message/Pop-up, etc. and the website must contain all such details.

title: Include disclaimer in certain advertisements
summary: Disclaimer shall be included in certain advertisements where specific securities are displayed as examples
required_action: Include disclaimer in certain advertisements
verbatim_text: In case any specific security/ securities are displayed in the advertisement as examples, disclaimer that 'The securities quoted are for illustration only and are not recommendatory' should be mentioned.

title: Include Disclaimer in Advertisements
summary: Investment Advisers must include a disclaimer in advertisements and communications with clients
required_action: Include the specified disclaimer
verbatim_text: Advertisements and communications/correspondences with clients shall include the disclaimer that “Registration granted by SEBI, enlistment with IAASB and certification from NISM in no way guarantee performance of the IA or provide any assurance of returns to investors.”

title: Prohibitions in Advertisements
summary: Investment Advisers must not include prohibited content in advertisements
required_action: Ensure advertisements do not contain prohibited content
verbatim_text: The advertisement shall not contain: Anything which is prohibited for publication under the law.

title: False or Misleading Statements in Advertisements
summary: Investment Advisers must not include false or misleading statements in advertisements
required_action: Ensure advertisements do not contain false or misleading statements
source_clause: c. Prohibitions in the advertisement: ii
verbatim_text: Statements which are false, misleading, biased or deceptive, based on assumptions or projections.

title: Misleading Testimonials in Advertisements
summary: Investment Advisers must not include misleading testimonials in advertisements
required_action: Ensure advertisements do not contain misleading testimonials
source_clause: c. Prohibitions in the advertisement: iii
verbatim_text: Any misleading or deceptive testimonials.

title: Statements that May Mislead Investors in Advertisements
summary: Investment Advisers must not include statements that may mislead investors in advertisements
required_action: Ensure advertisements do not contain statements that may mislead investors
source_clause: c. Prohibitions in the advertisement: iv
verbatim_text: Statements which, directly or by implication or by omission, may mislead the investor.

title: Statements Likely to be Misunderstood in Advertisements
summary: Investment Advisers must not include statements likely to be misunderstood in advertisements
required_action: Ensure advertisements do not contain statements likely to be misunderstood
source_clause: c. Prohibitions in the advertisement: v
verbatim_text: Any statement likely to be misunderstood or likely to disguise the significance of the same or any other statement contained in the advertisement.

title: Exploitative Statements in Advertisements
summary: Investment Advisers must not include exploitative statements in advertisements
required_action: Ensure advertisements do not contain exploitative statements
source_clause: c. Prohibitions in the advertisement: vi
verbatim_text: Any statement designed to exploit the lack of experience or knowledge of the investors.

title: Exaggerated or Inconsistent Statements in Advertisements
summary: Investment Advisers must not include exaggerated or inconsistent statements in advertisements
required_action: Ensure advertisements do not contain exaggerated or inconsistent statements
source_clause: c. Prohibitions in the advertisement: vii
verbatim_text: Any statement that is exaggerated or is inconsistent with or unrelated to the nature and risk and return profile of the product.

title: Technical or Complex Language in Advertisements
summary: Investment Advisers must not use technical or complex language in advertisements
required_action: Ensure advertisements do not use technical or complex language
source_clause: c. Prohibitions in the advertisement: viii
verbatim_text: Extensive use of technical or legal terminology or complex language and the inclusion of excessive details which may distract the investors.

title: Reference to Free Reports or Services in Advertisements
summary: Investment Advisers must not reference free reports or services in advertisements unless they are actually free
required_action: Ensure advertisements do not reference free reports or services unless they are actually free
source_clause: c. Prohibitions in the advertisement: ix
verbatim_text: Reference to any report, analysis, or service as free, unless it actually is free and without condition or obligation.

title: Guarantees of Returns in Advertisements
summary: Investment Advisers must not guarantee returns in advertisements
required_action: Ensure advertisements do not guarantee returns
source_clause: c. Prohibitions in the advertisement: x
verbatim_text: Any promise or guarantee of assured or risk free return to the investors.

title: Implying Assured Returns in Advertisements
summary: Investment Advisers must not imply assured returns in advertisements
required_action: Ensure advertisements do not imply assured returns
verbatim_text: The advertisement shall not imply any assured returns or minimum returns or target return or percentage accuracy or service provision till achievement of target returns or any other nomenclature that gives the impression to the client that the investment advice is risk-free and/or not susceptible to market risks and/or that it can generate returns with any level of assurance.

title: Discrediting Other Advertisements or Intermediaries in Advertisements
summary: Investment Advisers must not discredit other advertisements or intermediaries in advertisements
required_action: Ensure advertisements do not discredit other advertisements or intermediaries
source_clause: c. Prohibitions in the advertisement: xi
verbatim_text: Any statement which directly or indirectly discredits other advertisements or intermediaries or makes unfair comparisons or ascribes any qualitative advantage over other intermediaries directly or indirectly.

title: Reference to Past Performance in Advertisements
summary: Investment Advisers must not reference past performance in advertisements unless verified by PaRRVA
required_action: Ensure advertisements do not reference past performance unless verified by PaRRVA
source_clause: c. Prohibitions in the advertisement: xii
verbatim_text: Reference to past performance or risk-return metrics in respect of the services of Investment Adviser unless such risk-return metrics are verified by Past Risk and Return Verification Agency (PaRRVA) and claims using such metrics are made in the manner specified by SEBI.

title: Use of Superlative Terms in Advertisements
summary: Investment Advisers must not use superlative terms in advertisements
required_action: Ensure advertisements do not use superlative terms
source_clause: c. Prohibitions in the advertisement: xiii
verbatim_text: Superlative terms such as “Best”, “No. 1”, Top Adviser, “Leading”, “One of the best amongst market leaders”, etc. so as to provide any endorsement of quality or standing of the IA.

title: Use of SEBI Logo in Advertisements
summary: Investment Advisers must not use the SEBI logo in advertisements
required_action: Ensure advertisements do not use the SEBI logo
source_clause: c. Prohibitions in the advertisement: xiv
verbatim_text: Advertisements shall not include SEBI Logo.

title: Prior Approval for Advertisements
summary: Investment Advisers must obtain prior approval for advertisements from SEBI recognized supervisory body
required_action: Obtain prior approval from SEBI recognized supervisory body
verbatim_text: Prior approval for the advertisement/material shall be obtained from SEBI recognized supervisory body.

title: Suspension of Investment Adviser
summary: Investment Advisers must not issue advertisements during suspension
trigger: Suspension by SEBI or SEBI recognized supervisory body
required_action: Do not issue advertisements during suspension
verbatim_text: In the event of suspension of any IA by SEBI and/or by SEBI recognized supervisory body, the IA so suspended shall not issue any advertisement either singly or jointly with any other IA, during the period of suspension

title: Not engage in games or schemes
summary: Do not engage in games, leagues, schemes, competitions etc. which may involve distribution of prize monies, medals, gifts, etc.
required_action: not engage in games or schemes
evidence: record of games or schemes participated in
verbatim_text: The IA/RA shall not engage in games, leagues, schemes, competitions etc. which may involve distribution of prize monies, medals, gifts, etc.

title: Retain copy of advertisements
summary: Retain a copy of advertisements for a period of five years
required_action: retain a copy of the advertisement
deadline: five years from issuance
verbatim_text: Copy of the advertisement shall be retained by IA for a period of five years in terms of Regulation 19(2) of the IA Regulations.

title: Display IA information
summary: Display IA information such as name, logo, registration number, and address on portal/web site, notice board, display boards, advertisements, publications, know your client forms and client agreements
required_action: display IA information
evidence: IA information displayed on required materials
verbatim_text: The information such as name of the IA as registered with SEBI, its logo, its registration number and its complete address with telephone numbers shall be prominently displayed on portal/web site, if any, notice board, display boards, advertisements, publications, know your client forms and client agreements.

title: Not use SEBI logo
summary: Do not use the SEBI logo
required_action: not use SEBI logo
evidence: absence of SEBI logo on materials
verbatim_text: SEBI logo shall not be used by IA.

title: Establish internal code of conduct
summary: Establish a proper internal code of conduct and controls
required_action: establish internal code of conduct
verbatim_text: Proper internal code of conduct and controls should be put in place.

title: Guide employees on unauthenticated news
summary: Guide employees/temporary staff/voluntary workers to not encourage or circulate rumors or unverified information
required_action: guide employees on unauthenticated news
verbatim_text: Employees/temporary staff/voluntary workers etc. employed/working in the Offices of market intermediaries do not encourage or circulate rumours or unverified information obtained from client, industry, any trade or any other sources

title: Prevent Rumour Circulation
summary: Prevent employees from circulating unverified information
required_action: restrict access to blogs/chat forums/messenger sites
verbatim_text: Access to Blogs/ Chat forums/Messenger sites etc. should either be restricted under supervision or access should not be allowed.

title: Compliance Officer Approval Requirement
summary: Require Compliance Officer approval before forwarding market-related news
required_action: forward news only after Compliance Officer approval
verbatim_text: Employees should be directed that any market related news received by them either in their official mail/personal mail/blog or in any other manner, should be forwarded only after the same has been seen and approved by the IA’s Compliance Officer.

title: Outsourcing Restriction
summary: Do not outsource core business activities and compliance functions
required_action: do not outsource core business activities and compliance functions
verbatim_text: The intermediaries desirous of outsourcing their activities shall not, however, outsource their core business activities and compliance functions.

title: FIU Reporting Requirement
summary: Report suspicious transactions to FIU
required_action: report to FIU
verbatim_text: Reporting to Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU) - The intermediaries shall be responsible for reporting of any suspicious transactions / reports to FIU or any other competent authority in respect of activities carried out by the third parties.

title: KYC Compliance Requirement
summary: Comply with KYC regulations
required_action: comply with KYC regulations
verbatim_text: Regarding Know Your Client (KYC) requirements, the intermediaries shall comply with the provisions of SEBI {KYC (Know Your Client) Registration Agency) Regulations, 2011 and Guidelines issued thereunder from time to time.

title: Log Maintenance Requirement
summary: Maintain logs of blog/chat forum/messenger site usage
required_action: maintain logs
verbatim_text: Logs for any usage of such Blogs/Chat forums/Messenger sites (called by any nomenclature) shall be treated as records and the same should be maintained as specified by the IA Regulations.

title: Reporting Suspicious Transactions
summary: Report suspicious transactions to FIU or other competent authorities
required_action: report to FIU or other competent authorities
verbatim_text: be responsible for reporting of any suspicious transactions / reports to FIU or any other competent authority in respect of activities carried out by the third parties.

title: Encouraging Clients to Use Centralized Fee Collection Mechanism
summary: Encourage clients to use the centralized fee collection mechanism
required_action: encourage clients to use the centralized fee collection mechanism
verbatim_text: Registered IAs and RAs shall encourage their clients to use this mechanism.

title: Adhere to Conflict of Interest Guidelines
summary: Intermediaries must adhere to guidelines for avoiding or dealing with conflict of interest
required_action: Adhere to guidelines
verbatim_text: Intermediaries shall adhere to these guidelines for avoiding or dealing with or managing conflict of interest.

title: Establish Internal Policies and Procedures
summary: Intermediaries must lay down policies and internal procedures to identify and avoid or deal with conflict of interest
required_action: Establish internal policies and procedures
evidence: Documentation of internal policies and procedures
verbatim_text: lay down, with active involvement of senior management, policies and internal procedures to identify and avoid or to deal or manage actual or potential conflict of interest

title: Maintain High Standards of Integrity
summary: Intermediaries must maintain high standards of integrity in the conduct of their business
required_action: Maintain high standards of integrity
verbatim_text: at all times maintain high standards of integrity in the conduct of their business

title: Ensure Fair Treatment of Clients
summary: Intermediaries must ensure fair treatment of their clients and not discriminate amongst them
required_action: Ensure fair treatment of clients
verbatim_text: ensure fair treatment of their clients and not discriminate amongst them

title: Prioritize Client Interest
summary: Intermediaries must ensure that their personal interest does not conflict with their duty to their clients
required_action: Prioritize client interest
evidence: Documentation of prioritization of client interest
verbatim_text: ensure that their personal interest does not, at any time conflict with their duty to their clients and client’s interest always takes primacy in their advice, investment decisions and transactions

title: Reduce Opportunities for Conflict
summary: Intermediaries must endeavor to reduce opportunities for conflict through prescriptive measures
required_action: Reduce opportunities for conflict
verbatim_text: endeavor to reduce opportunities for conflict through prescriptive measures such as through information barriers to block or hinder the flow of information from one department/ unit to another, etc.

title: Place Restrictions on Transactions
summary: Intermediaries must place appropriate restrictions on transactions in securities while handling a mandate of issuer or client
required_action: Place restrictions on transactions
verbatim_text: place appropriate restrictions on transactions in securities while handling a mandate of issuer or client in respect of such security so as to avoid any conflict

title: Not Deal in Securities with Material Non-Published Information
summary: Intermediaries must not deal in securities while in possession of material non-published information
required_action: Not deal in securities with material non-published information
evidence: Documentation of non-dealing with material non-published information
verbatim_text: not deal in securities while in possession of material non published information

title: Not Communicate Material Non-Published Information
summary: Intermediaries must not communicate material non-published information while dealing in securities on behalf of others
required_action: Not communicate material non-published information
evidence: Documentation of non-communication of material non-published information
verbatim_text: not communicate the material non published information while dealing in securities on behalf of others

title: Not Contribute to Market Manipulation
summary: Intermediaries must not contribute to manipulate the demand for or supply of securities in the market or to influence prices of securities
required_action: Not contribute to market manipulation
verbatim_text: not in any way contribute to manipulate the demand for or supply of securities in the market or to influence prices of securities

title: Not Have Incentive Structure that Encourages Sale of Unsuitable Products
summary: Intermediaries must not have an incentive structure that encourages sale of products not suiting the risk profile of their clients
required_action: Not have incentive structure that encourages sale of unsuitable products
verbatim_text: not have an incentive structure that encourages sale of products not suiting the risk profile of their clients

title: Not Share Client Information for Personal Interest
summary: Intermediaries must not share information received from clients or pertaining to them for their personal interest
required_action: Not share client information for personal interest
evidence: Documentation of non-sharing of client information
verbatim_text: not share information received from clients or pertaining to them, obtained as a result of their dealings, for their personal interest

title: Provide Free Access to Securities Market Data
summary: Make available securities market data free of charge for viewing and download
required_action: Make data available free of charge
verbatim_text: As far as the data provided by various data sources in Indian securities markets pursuant to regulatory mandates for reporting and disclosure in public domain are concerned, such data should be made available to users, 'free of charge' both for 'viewing' the data as also for download in the format as specified by regulatory mandate for reporting, as well as their usage for the value addition purposes.

title: Association with Certain Persons
summary: Investment Advisers must refer to the circulars regarding association with certain persons
required_action: Refer to the circulars
evidence: Record of referral to the circulars
verbatim_text: IAs are advised to refer to the following circulars with respect to Association of Persons regulated by the Board:

title: Accreditation to Investors
summary: Investment Advisers must refer to the circulars regarding accreditation to investors
required_action: Refer to the circulars
evidence: Record of referral to the circulars
verbatim_text: IAs are advised to refer to the following circulars with respect to accreditation to investors:

title: Recognition and Operationalization of PaRRVA
summary: Investment Advisers must comply with the regulations regarding PaRRVA
required_action: Comply with the regulations
evidence: Record of compliance with the regulations
source_circular: Regulation 16D and 16E of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Intermediaries) Regulations, 2008
verbatim_text: Regulation 16D and 16E of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Intermediaries) Regulations, 2008

title: Refer to MITRA Circular
summary: Investment Advisers must refer to the circular on Service platform for investors to trace inactive and unclaimed Mutual Fund folios
trigger: Service platform for investors to trace inactive and unclaimed Mutual Fund folios
required_action: Refer to circular no. SEBI/HO/IMD/IMD-SEC-3/P/CIR/2025/15
evidence: Record of referral to the circular
verbatim_text: IAs are advised to refer to circular no. SEBI/HO/IMD/IMD-SEC-3/P/CIR/2025/15 dated February 12, 2025 on ‘Service platform for investors to trace inactive and unclaimed Mutual Fund folios-MITRA

title: Adopt Cybersecurity and Cyber Resilience Framework
summary: Investment Advisers must adopt the Cybersecurity and Cyber Resilience Framework
required_action: Adopt and implement the Cybersecurity and Cyber Resilience Framework
evidence: Record of adoption and implementation of the framework
verbatim_text: IAs are advised to refer to the following circulars with respect to Cybersecurity and Cyber Resilience Framework (CSCRF)

title: Conduct Annual Audit
summary: Conduct annual audit in respect of compliance with IA regulations and circulars
required_action: Conduct audit and submit report
deadline: Within six months from the end of each financial year and submit report within one month from the date of the audit report but not later than October 31st of each year
verbatim_text: In terms of regulation 19(3) of the IA Regulations, IA is required to conduct annual audit in respect of compliance with the IA regulations and circulars issued thereunder from a member of Institute of Chartered Accountants of India or Institute of Company Secretaries of India within six months from the end of each financial year.

title: Include Terms and Conditions in Agreement
summary: Ensure that the agreement includes specific terms and conditions
required_action: Include terms and conditions in the agreement
deadline: Before providing services
source_clause: Regulation 19(1)(d) of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Investment Advisers) Regulations, 2013
verbatim_text: Investment Adviser shall ensure that the following terms and conditions are incorporated in the Investment Advisory Agreement: ... In accordance with the applicable laws, client hereby appoints, entirely at his / her / its risk, the Investment Adviser to provide the required services in accordance with the terms and conditions of the agreement as mandated under Regulation19(1)(d) of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Investment Advisers) Regulations, 2013.

title: Not Imply Assured Returns
summary: Not imply assured returns or risk-free investment advice
required_action: Not imply assured returns or risk-free investment advice
deadline: null
verbatim_text: Investment Adviser shall not, in the course of performing its services to the client, hold out any investment advice implying any assured returns or minimum returns or target return or percentage accuracy or service provision till achievement of target returns or any other nomenclature that gives the impression to the client that the investment advice is risk-free and/or not susceptible to market risks and or that it can generate returns with any level of assurance.

title: Disclose Fees
summary: Disclose fees to the client
required_action: Disclose fees to the client
deadline: Before providing services
verbatim_text: Fees specified under Investment Adviser Regulations and relevant circulars issued thereunder. ... Fees charged to the client.

title: Act in Fiduciary Capacity
summary: Act in the best interest of clients at all times
required_action: Act in a fiduciary capacity towards clients
evidence: Records of client interactions and advice provided
verbatim_text: The Investment Adviser shall act in a fiduciary capacity towards its clients at all times.

title: Comply with Investment Adviser Regulations
summary: Comply with the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Investment Advisers) Regulations, 2013
required_action: Comply with the regulations and its amendments
source_clause: 4. Functions of the Investment Adviser, a) Terms of compliance
verbatim_text: Terms of compliance with the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Investment Advisers) Regulations, 2013 and its amendments, rules, circulars and notifications.

title: Maintain Records
summary: Maintain client-wise records
required_action: Maintain client-wise KYC, risk assessment, analysis reports, and other records
source_clause: 4. Functions of the Investment Adviser, e) Maintenance of records
verbatim_text: Maintenance of records i.e. client-wise KYC, risk assessment, analysis reports of investment advice and suitability, terms and conditions document, related books of accounts and a register containing list of clients along with dated investment advice and its rationale

title: Conduct Risk Assessment
summary: Conduct risk assessment for each client
required_action: Conduct risk assessment including risk capacity and risk aversion
evidence: Records of risk assessment for each client
source_clause: 4. Functions of the Investment Adviser, c) Risk assessment procedure of client
verbatim_text: Risk assessment procedure of client including their risk capacity and risk aversion.

title: Provide Reports to Clients
summary: Provide reports to clients on potential and current investments
required_action: Provide reports to clients on potential and current investments
evidence: Records of reports provided to clients
source_clause: 4. Functions of the Investment Adviser, d) Providing reports to clients
verbatim_text: Providing reports to clients on potential and current investments.

title: Abide by Code of Conduct
summary: Abide by the Code of Conduct specified in the regulations
required_action: Abide by the Code of Conduct
evidence: Records of compliance with the Code of Conduct
source_clause: 4. Functions of the Investment Adviser, g) Undertaking to abide by the Code of Conduct
verbatim_text: Undertaking to abide by the Code of Conduct as specified in the Third Schedule of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Investment Advisers) Regulations, 2013.

title: Comply with Audit Requirements
summary: Comply with audit requirements as specified in the regulations
required_action: Comply with audit requirements
source_clause: 4. Functions of the Investment Adviser, f) Provisions regarding audit
verbatim_text: Provisions regarding audit as per the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Investment Advisers) Regulations, 2013.

title: Comply with Eligibility Criteria
summary: Comply with eligibility criteria as specified in the regulations
required_action: Comply with eligibility criteria
evidence: Records of compliance with eligibility criteria
source_clause: 4. Functions of the Investment Adviser, b) Compliance with the eligibility criteria
verbatim_text: Compliance with the eligibility criteria as specified under the Investment Adviser Regulations at all times.

title: Provide 30 days prior written notice for voluntary termination
summary: Investment Adviser must provide 30 days prior written notice to the client in case of voluntary termination
required_action: Provide 30 days prior written notice to the client
evidence: Record of written notice provided to the client
deadline: within 30 days
verbatim_text: In case of a voluntary termination of the agreement, the client would be required to give a 30 days prior written notice while the Investment Adviser would be required to give a 30 days prior written notice.

title: Maintain arms-length relationship with related parties
summary: Investment Adviser must maintain an arms-length relationship with related parties
required_action: Maintain arms-length relationship and disclose conflicts
evidence: Record of disclosures and arms-length relationship maintenance
verbatim_text: The Investment Adviser to clearly declare that it is carrying on its activities independently, at an arms-length basis with its related parties. Disclosures of conflicts to be made.

title: Not provide distribution services to advisory clients
summary: Investment Adviser must not provide distribution services to advisory clients
required_action: Not provide distribution services
evidence: Record of non-provision of distribution services
source_clause: 12. Investment Adviser engaged in other activities
verbatim_text: The Investment Adviser (individual) to represent to the client that it maintains an arms-length relationship between its activities as an investment adviser and other activities and to covenant that this arm’s length relationship shall be maintained throughout the tenure of advisory service; (a) to represent that they shall not provide any distribution services.

title: Not seek Power of Attorney from the client
summary: Investment Adviser must not seek Power of Attorney from the client
required_action: Not seek Power of Attorney
evidence: Record of non-seek of Power of Attorney
source_clause: 14. No right to seek Power of Attorney
verbatim_text: The Investment Adviser to clearly declare that it shall

title: Not Seek Power of Attorney
summary: Investment Adviser must not seek power of attorney from clients
required_action: Clearly declare that it shall not seek any power of attorney or authorizations from its clients
verbatim_text: The Investment Adviser to clearly declare that it shall not seek any power of attorney or authorizations from its clients for implementation of investment advice.

title: Disclose Conflicts of Interest
summary: Investment Adviser must disclose all conflicts of interest
trigger: When a conflict of interest arises
required_action: Disclose all conflicts of interest and not derive any direct or indirect benefit out of the client’s securities/investment products
verbatim_text: The Investment Adviser to clearly declare that it will disclose all conflicts of interest as and when they arise and not derive any direct or indirect benefit out of the client’s securities/investment products.

title: Maintain Client Accounts and Data
summary: Investment Adviser must maintain client accounts and data
required_action: Maintain client accounts and data as mandated under the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Investment Advisers) Regulations, 2013
verbatim_text: Investment Adviser shall be responsible for maintenance of client accounts and data as mandated under the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Investment Advisers) Regulations, 2013.

title: Specify Fee Payment Mode
summary: Investment Adviser must specify fee payment mode
required_action: Specify that the payment of fees shall be through a mode which shows traceability of funds
verbatim_text: The payment of fees shall be through a mode which shows traceability of funds.

title: State Liability
summary: Investment Adviser must state liability
required_action: Clearly state that the Investment Adviser shall not incur any liability by reason of any loss, which a client may suffer by reason of any depletion in the value of the assets under advice
verbatim_text: The agreement to clearly state that the Investment Adviser shall not incur any liability by reason of any loss, which a client may suffer by reason of any depletion in the value of the assets under advice, which may result by reason of fluctuation in asset value, or by reason of non-performance or underperformance of the securities/funds or any other market conditions.

title: Make Representations
summary: Investment Adviser must make representations
required_action: Make adequate and appropriate representations about qualifications of the adviser, principal officer, persons associated with the investment advice, receipt of all applicable approvals and consents
verbatim_text: Adequate and appropriate representations about qualifications of the adviser, principal officer, persons associated with the investment advice, receipt of all applicable approvals and consents (from regulatory / statutory bodies, third party consents, corporate approvals etc.) and covenant to maintain them throughout the validity of advisory service.

title: Plan for Death or Disability of Client
summary: Investment Adviser must plan for death or disability of client
required_action: Incorporate provisions in relation to continuation / termination of the advisory service in event of client's death / disability, succession, nomination, representation etc.
verbatim_text: Provisions in relation to continuation / termination of the advisory service in event of client's death / disability, succession, nomination, representation etc. to be incorporated.

title: Plan for Death or Disability of Investment Adviser
summary: Investment Adviser must plan for death or disability of investment adviser
required_action: Appoint one of its legal heirs, executor, trustee, administrator of estate of the deceased as the person-in-charge in the event of investment adviser’s death / disability
verbatim_text: Every individual investment adviser must appoint one of its legal heirs, executor, trustee, administrator of estate of the deceased (the “Obligor”) as the person-in-charge in the event of investment adviser’s death / disability.

title: Protect client interest in case of IA's death/disability
summary: Ensure protection of client interest and redressal of client claims in case of IA's death or disability
required_action: Appoint an Obligor to take charge and protect client interest
verbatim_text: The agreement must disclose the steps to be taken by the Obligor in the event of the above eventuality in order to ensure protection of interest of the clients and redressal of clients' claims

title: Establish dispute resolution mechanism
summary: Establish a dispute resolution mechanism, including arbitration
required_action: Establish a dispute resolution mechanism, including arbitration
verbatim_text: Adequate provisions to cover protection of acts done in good faith as well as for dispute resolution mechanism including arbitration

title: Resolve client grievances within timelines
summary: Resolve client grievances within the timelines specified by SEBI
required_action: Resolve client grievance within SEBI-specified timelines
verbatim_text: Investment Adviser shall be responsible to resolve the grievances within the timelines specified under SEBI circulars

title: Not guarantee returns to clients
summary: Not guarantee returns, accuracy, or risk-free investments to clients
required_action: Not guarantee returns, accuracy, or risk-free investments
verbatim_text: The IA does not guarantee returns, accuracy, or risk-free investments. All advice is subject to market risks, and there is no assurance of any returns or profits

title: Not offer prohibited schemes to clients
summary: Not offer assured, guaranteed, or fixed return schemes to clients
required_action: Not offer assured, guaranteed, or fixed return schemes
verbatim_text: Any assured/guaranteed/fixed returns schemes or any other schemes of similar nature are prohibited by law. No scheme of this nature shall be offered to the client by the IA

title: Cybersecurity and Cyber Resilience
summary: Investment Advisers must adopt a Cybersecurity and Cyber Resilience Framework (CSCRF)
required_action: Adopt a CSCRF
verbatim_text: Cybersecurity and Cyber Resilience Framework (CSCRF)

title: Client Identification and Segregation
summary: Use Permanent Account Number (PAN) of each client as the control record for identification and client level segregation
trigger: Onboarding of new clients or existing clients wishing to take advisory or distribution services
required_action: Use PAN of each client as the control record for identification and client level segregation
evidence: Records of client PAN and segregation of advisory and distribution activities
source_circular: SEBI/HO/IMD/DF1/CIR/P/2020/182 dated September 23, 2020 and SEBI/HO/MIRSD/ MIRSD-PoD-1/P/CIR/2025/003 dated January 08, 2025
verbatim_text: Permanent Account Number (PAN) of each client shall be the control record for identification and client level segregation.

title: Family of Client
summary: Reckon 'family of client' as a single client and use PAN of all members in 'family of client' jointly and severally as the control record
trigger: Onboarding of new clients or existing clients wishing to take advisory or distribution services
required_action: Reckon 'family of client' as a single client and use PAN of all members in 'family of client' jointly and severally as the control record
evidence: Records of client PAN and segregation of advisory and distribution activities
source_circular: SEBI/HO/IMD/DF1/CIR/P/2020/182 dated September 23, 2020 and SEBI/HO/MIRSD/ MIRSD-PoD-1/P/CIR/2025/003 dated January 08, 2025
verbatim_text: In case of an individual client, 'family of client'3 shall be reckoned as a single client and PAN of all members in 'family of client' would jointly and severally be the control

title: Charge Fees in Specified Manner
summary: Charge fees from clients in the manner specified by SEBI
trigger: Onboarding of new clients or change of fee mode
required_action: Charge fees in accordance with SEBI regulations
verbatim_text: Regulation 15A of the IA Regulations provides that IAs shall be entitled to charge fees from a client in the manner as specified by SEBI.

title: Demonstrate AUA with Supporting Documents
summary: Demonstrate AUA with supporting documents like demat statements, unit statements etc.
required_action: Demonstrate AUA with supporting documents
evidence: Supporting documents like demat statements, unit statements etc.
verbatim_text: IA shall be required to demonstrate AUA with supporting documents like demat statements, unit statements etc. of the client.

title: Obtain Client Signature on Agreement
summary: Ensure that clients sign the agreement before rendering investment advice or charging fees
required_action: Obtain client signature on agreement
verbatim_text: IA shall ensure that neither any investment advice is rendered nor any fee is charged until the client has signed the aforesaid agreement and provided copy of signed agreement to the client.

title: Inform Existing Clients about MITC
summary: Inform existing clients about the MITC via email or other suitable mode of communication
required_action: Inform existing clients about MITC
evidence: Records of communication with existing clients
verbatim_text: For the existing clients as on February 17, 2025, the MITC shall be informed by the IAs to the clients via email or any other suitable mode of communication (which can be preserved) by June 30, 2025.

title: Charge advance fees not exceeding one year
summary: Charge advance fees not exceeding fees for a period of one year
trigger: Agreement with client to charge fees in advance
required_action: Charge advance fees not exceeding one year
verbatim_text: If agreed by the client, IAs may charge fees in advance, however, such advance shall not exceed fees for a period of one year.

title: Comply with client limits and fee collection
summary: Comply with applicable limits on the number of clients and fee collected
trigger: Failure to get registration as non-individual IA
required_action: Comply with applicable client limits and fee collection
evidence: Records of client count and fee collection
verbatim_text: such IA shall continue the advisory activities as an Individual IA while ensuring the applicable limits on the number of clients and fee collected

title: Provide undertaking for segregation of services
summary: Provide an undertaking stating segregation of investment advisory and research services
trigger: Registration as both investment adviser and research analyst
required_action: Provide an undertaking stating segregation of services
verbatim_text: Such IA/RA shall provide an undertaking stating that it shall maintain arms-length relationship between its activity as IA and RA and shall ensure that its investment advisory services and research services are clearly segregated from each other

title: Take all consents and permissions from the client
summary: Investment Adviser must take all consents and permissions from the client before undertaking any actions
trigger: Undertaking any actions in relation to the securities or investment product
required_action: Take all consents and permissions from the client
evidence: Record of consents and permissions obtained from the client
verbatim_text: The investment adviser to ensure that it will take all consents and permissions from the client prior to undertaking any actions in relation to the securities or investment product advised by the investment adviser.

title: Terms of Fees and Billing
summary: Investment Adviser shall provide specific details on fees
required_action: provide specific details on fees
verbatim_text: Provide specific details on the following: ... The payment of fees shall be through a mode which shows traceability of funds.

title: Representations and Covenants
summary: Investment Adviser shall make representations and covenants
required_action: make representations and covenants
verbatim_text: Adequate and appropriate representations about qualifications of the adviser, principal officer, persons associated with the investment advice, receipt of all applicable approvals and consents...

title: Death or Disability of Client
summary: Investment Adviser shall have provisions for client death or disability
required_action: have provisions for client death or disability
verbatim_text: Provisions in relation to continuation / termination of the advisory service in event of client's death / disability, succession, nomination, representation etc. to be incorporated.

title: Death or Disability of Investment Adviser
summary: Investment Adviser shall appoint Obligor
required_action: appoint Obligor
verbatim_text: Every individual investment adviser must appoint one of its legal heirs, executor, trustee, administrator of estate of the deceased (the “Obligor”) as the person-in-charge in the event of investment adviser’s death / disability.

title: Client Consent for Trades
summary: Obtain client consent for every trade
required_action: Obtain client's specific and positive consent
verbatim_text: IA cannot execute/carry out any trade (purchase/sell transaction) on behalf of the client without his/her/its specific and positive consent on every trade.

title: Advance Fee Payment
summary: Comply with advance fee payment rules
trigger: When receiving advance fees from clients
required_action: Do not exceed the stipulated period and refund proportionate fees for unexpired periods
evidence: Fee payment records and refund documents
verbatim_text: IA may charge fees in advance if agreed by the client. Such advance shall not exceed the period stipulated by SEBI; presently it is maximum one year. In case of premature termination of the IA services by the client or the IA, the client shall be entitled to seek refund of proportionate fees only for unexpired period.

title: Client Information Collection
summary: Collect client financial information
required_action: Collect client's financial information
verbatim_text: The IA is expected to know the client’s financial details for providing services. Hence, the client is required to share the financial information (e.g. income, existing investments, liabilities, etc.) with the IA.
