title: Close Impersonation Related Complaints
summary: Close impersonation related complaints after following due process
required_action: Close complaints after following due process
verbatim_text: IA must close such impersonation related complaints after following the due process as specified by SEBI/ IAASB

title: Post-Registration Applications
summary: Investment Advisers must submit post-registration applications for changes
trigger: Change in control or other details
required_action: Submit post-registration application to SEBI
verbatim_text: Initial scrutiny of post-registration applications for ensuring completeness of submission of information/ documents along with recommendation on the applications to SEBI

title: Annual Compliance Audit Report
summary: Investment Advisers must submit Annual Compliance Audit Report
required_action: Submit Annual Compliance Audit Report to RAASB/IAASB
verbatim_text: Monitoring the activities of RAs/IAs by obtaining Annual Compliance Audit Report

title: Periodical Reports
summary: Investment Advisers must submit periodical reports to SEBI
required_action: Submit periodical reports to SEBI
source_clause: 7. Submission of periodical reports to SEBI
verbatim_text: Submission of periodical reports to SEBI

title: Enlistment with RAASB for Existing RAs
summary: Existing RAs must be deemed enlisted with RAASB
trigger: Existing registration as a Research Analyst
required_action: Be deemed enlisted with RAASB
verbatim_text: Existing RAs registered with SEBI shall be deemed to be enlisted with RAASB

title: Enlistment with IAASB for Existing IAs
summary: Existing IAs must be deemed enlisted with IAASB
trigger: Existing registration as an Investment Adviser and membership with BASL
required_action: Be deemed enlisted with IAASB
evidence: Registration confirmation from SEBI and membership confirmation from BASL
verbatim_text: Existing IAs registered with SEBI who are also members of BASL38 shall be deemed to be enlisted with the IAASB recognised under this framework

title: Enlistment with RAASB/IAASB for New Applicants
summary: New applicants must enlist with RAASB/IAASB
trigger: Submission of new application for registration as an Investment Adviser
required_action: Enlist with RAASB/IAASB
verbatim_text: New applications received from the effective date of operationalization of RAASB/IAASB framework shall be routed through RAASB/IAASB

title: Submission of Periodic Reports
summary: Submit periodic reports to RAASB/ IAASB
required_action: Submit periodic reports
verbatim_text: all registered RAs/ IAs shall submit periodic reports to RAASB/ IAASB in the manner specified by SEBI

title: Disclose complaint status on website
summary: Investment Adviser must disclose the status of complaints on its website
required_action: Disclose complaint status on website
verbatim_text: To disclose the status of complaints on its website.

title: Disclose registration details on website
summary: Investment Adviser must disclose its registration details on its website
required_action: Disclose registration details on website
verbatim_text: To disclose the name, proprietor name, type of registration, registration number, validity, complete address with telephone numbers and associated SEBI Office details (i.e. Head office/ regional/ local Office) on its website.

title: Employ only qualified and certified employees
summary: Investment Adviser must employ only qualified and certified employees
required_action: Employ only qualified and certified employees
verbatim_text: To employ only qualified and certified employees.

title: Maintain records of client interactions
summary: Investment Adviser must maintain records of interactions with all clients
required_action: Maintain records of client interactions
verbatim_text: To maintain records of interactions, with all clients including prospective clients (prior to onboarding), where any conversation related to advice has taken place.

title: Ensure advertisements comply with the Advertisement Code
summary: Investment Adviser must ensure all advertisements comply with the Advertisement Code for Investment Advisers
required_action: Ensure advertisements comply with the Advertisement Code
verbatim_text: To ensure that all advertisements are in adherence to the provisions of the Advertisement Code for Investment Advisers

title: Not discriminate among clients
summary: Investment Adviser must not discriminate among clients in terms of services provided
required_action: Not discriminate among clients
verbatim_text: Not to discriminate in terms of services provided, among clients opting for same/similar products/services offered by investment adviser.

title: Onboarding of Clients
summary: Onboard clients by sharing agreement copy and completing KYC
trigger: When a new client is acquired
required_action: Share agreement copy and complete KYC
evidence: Record of agreement copy shared and KYC completed
verbatim_text: Onboarding of Clients, Sharing of agreement copy, Completing KYC of clients

title: Conflict of Interest Disclosure
summary: Disclose any conflict of interest
required_action: Disclose any conflict of interest
evidence: Record of conflict of interest disclosed to clients
verbatim_text: To disclose any conflict of interest of the investment advisory activities with any other activities of the investment adviser

title: Artificial Intelligence Disclosure
summary: Disclose the extent of use of Artificial Intelligence tools
required_action: Disclose the extent of use of Artificial Intelligence tools
evidence: Record of Artificial Intelligence tool disclosure to clients
verbatim_text: To disclose the extent of use of Artificial Intelligence tools in providing investment advisory services

title: Investment Advice
summary: Provide investment advice based on risk-profiling and suitability
required_action: Provide investment advice based on risk-profiling and suitability
evidence: Record of investment advice provided to clients
verbatim_text: To provide investment advice to the client based on the risk-profiling of the clients and suitability of the client

title: Honesty and Integrity
summary: Treat all advisory clients with honesty and integrity
required_action: Treat all advisory clients with honesty and integrity
evidence: Record of honest and integrity-based interactions with clients
verbatim_text: To treat all advisory clients with honesty and integrity

title: Material Facts Disclosure
summary: Make adequate disclosure of material facts
required_action: Make adequate disclosure of material facts
evidence: Record of material facts disclosed to clients
verbatim_text: To make adequate disclosure to the investor of all material facts such as risks, obligations, costs, etc. relating to the products or securities advised by the adviser

title: Complex Products Guidance
summary: Provide clear guidance and adequate caution notice for complex products
trigger: When providing investment advice for complex products
required_action: Provide clear guidance and adequate caution notice
evidence: Record of guidance and caution notice provided to clients
verbatim_text: To provide clear guidance and adequate caution notice to clients when providing investment advice for dealing in complex and high-risk financial products/services

title: Confidentiality
summary: Ensure confidentiality of client information
required_action: Ensure confidentiality of client information
evidence: Record of confidentiality measures in place
verbatim_text: To ensure confidentiality of information shared by clients unless such information is required to be provided in furtherance of discharging legal obligations or a client has provided specific consent to share such information

title: Timelines Disclosure
summary: Disclose timelines for various services
required_action: Disclose timelines for various services
evidence: Record of timelines disclosed to clients
verbatim_text: To disclose the timelines for the various services provided by the investment adviser to clients and ensure adherence to the said timelines
